name: BAHN test · driver report via Telegram

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_DEMO_CHAT_ID, text: 'Driver, ' + $('Prepare').first().json.name + ' (' + $('Prepare').first().json.order_ref + '):\n' + $('Prepare').first().json.text, reply_parameters: { message_id: Number($('Prepare').first().json.reply_to) || 0, allow_sending_without_reply: true } }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, output: `Posted as the driver of ${$('Prepare').first().json.order_ref} on Telegram. The agent reads it like a real driver message; its report appears here in a few minutes.` } }];
